lines.text: Jesus was about thirty-three when he was crucified. He died at three in the afternoon.
Three crosses stood on the hill.
He died, he was buried, and he rose again on the third day.
Three women came to the tomb: Mary Magdalene, Mary the mother of James, and Salome.
All of this after about three years of ministry.
And today, about one in three people on earth call themselves Christian.
Peter denied Jesus three times.
And after he rose, Jesus asked him three times:
Do you love me? Do you love me? Do you love me?
God is Father, Son, and Holy Spirit.
And three is all through the world he made. Every colour comes from three: red, yellow, and blue.
Birth, life, and death. Past, present, and future.
Time, space, and matter. Ice, water, and steam.
Height, width, and depth. Body, soul, and spirit.
A father, a mother, and a child.
In the garden of Gethsemane, Jesus fell on his face, and prayed three times.
Each time, he came back to Peter, James, and John. And three times, he found them asleep.
And how does the Bible say we are saved? By trusting in his death, his burial, and his resurrection.
In the Bible, three is the number of completeness. When God says it three times, it is settled.
That is why the angels cry: Holy, holy, holy.
And God blesses us in three names. Say it with me:
In the name of the Father, the Son, and the Holy Spirit. Amen.
Share this with your friends, your family, and the people around you, so they can hear God's word.
